- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ancient Romans used a variety of instruments, including:

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tuba: a long, straight horn made of bronze or brass used in military and musical performances.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lyre: a stringed instrument similar to a small harp, used to accompany singing.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Panpipes: a series of pipes of varying lengths played together for melodic sound.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sistrum: a percussion instrument used in religious ceremonies, made of metal or bronze.
